context: Post-publication GitHub line-by-line audit of v1.3.0

findings.finding: windows/RELEASE.json remained PASS_RELEASE_READY / publication=PENDING after v1.3.0 was publicly published and verified.
findings.rootCause: release_metadata_audit.py validated root RELEASE.json, SHA256SUMS, README, Windows manifest and Linux UI version but did not validate platform release metadata publication state.
findings.fix: Promote windows/RELEASE.json to published-verified and extend release_metadata_audit.py to compare platform publication metadata to root authority.

findings.finding: Required windows-source protected check did not run full windows_contract_audit.py; full contract ran only after immutable v* tag creation.
findings.rootCause: Full audit requires ignored pinned PowerShell runtime, restored only in tag-specific windows-release-contract job.
findings.fix: Restore pinned PowerShell runtime and run full Windows + Router Gateway contract audits in windows-source before merge; retain tag recheck.

invariants: No v1.3.0 tag or release asset mutation.
Root and delivery SHA256SUMS already exact-equal.
nextGate: Protected GitHub PR required checks linux-source + windows-source must PASS before merge.
